neighbours.label: Internal continuations in spellings beginning Vas, Bas, cas or Vis
fire: The review was signed by Elena Vasconcellos on Monday.
The librarian found a letter addressed to Professor Bascom.
The passenger list included a traveler named Vasco.
The guide led our party through the casbah before sunset.
The organizer thanked Viswa for arranging the lecture.
The catalogue lists an essay by Nicholas Basbanes.
A researcher named Paulo Vasconcellos presented the final chart.
The hotel receptionist handed Mr Bascom his room key.

notes: The six card peaks continue Vasconcellos, Bascom, Vasco, casbah, Viswa and Basbanes. The proposed orthographic family is tentative; controls replace names or words in the same frames. No semantic grouping is claimed. Codex-authored; cards only.
